ADVISOR PRIORITY (23:11): the operator has seen no merge for 4 hours. Next, after the #2611/#2613 reviews you have in flight:
1. #2612 (TASK-1742, test-only fixture pin) and #2616 (BUG-2121, docs completeness): STANDARD tier under ADR-76. Both are FACTORY READY and green, with no holds. Run one fresh reviewer each. Block only on real defects, unmet acceptance or contract drift. No mutation campaign: a surviving mutation is a follow-up. Merge pinned as soon as they approve. These are your fastest merges.
2. #2611 (BUG-2014): when it approves, post 'MERGE: approved ... awaiting advisor signoff' and I'll sign off at once.
3. I've taken #2599 (BUG-2004) and #2610 (BUG-2006) off your plate. I commissioned fresh strict reviewers for both (agy-authored, so I'm not a co-author). Don't start a review on either.
4. #2614: REQUEST CHANGES routed to the Codex factory, round 2 (headless). You run the fresh reviewer after FACTORY READY.
subject: Fast-track #2612/#2616; advisor took #2599/#2610
